ranking_note: Authored from the before descriptions at commit 408a7cc654e34d620ebd557b2d6943448a4365a1, frozen before the rewrite; protocol per /playbooks:skill-authoring ## Measurement. Same-plugin competitor only: verification:confirm (proving a change achieved its intended outcome after a build, test and lint prerequisite). measure owns checking a measurable-improvement claim against a baseline captured before the change: performance (wall time, memory, allocations, throughput, latency) or code metrics (complexity, coverage, coupling), each with a baseline phase and a compare phase, and an honest cannot-quantify when no baseline exists.
